Keep a ref in what?
Added a related issue link to 1912.
I am noting that this ticket (
) includes mention of relating to the resolution of both:
https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-1737
and
https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-1738
We should be keeping these two tickets in mind during the Fixity spec drafting... as use cases that must be supported.
I guess I don't see that, but if you do, it doesn't bother me to have the link.
This task is to redesign the fcr:fixity service to be more in line with RESTful LDP interaction models.
For example, similar to the way that all non-RDF sources have an associated fcr:metadata resource, all resources (RDF or not) should possibly have an fcr:fixity resource.
When performing a GET on fcr:fixity, the most recent fixity check outcome should possibly be returned.
When performing a POST on fcr:fixity, a new fixity check should be run with a newly created outcome resource added as a child of fcr:fixity.
The completion of this ticket should also take into consideration:
Publish "fixity" message :
https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-1407
